description: Standalone Morphe patches for Gboard Rambler: Long-press Spacebar for Rambler (Smart Hybrid / Hold-to-Talk / Toggle modes, zero extra height, works with or without Cursor Trackpad while preserving Spacebar-swipe Trackpad), draggable Rambler Toolbar quick-access button, 1-Tap Fix & Learn from Dictation History, Hex by Anomaly waveforms, Per-App Custom Instructions & Behavior Overrides, Productivity Tools (private On-Device Dictation Stats card, opt-in Hands-Free Voice Send/Search suffixes, deterministic Voice Snippets, Find & Replace + Strip Trailing Period, private Local Dictation History, Auto Parallel Retry, Longer Dictation Sessions, JSON Backup & Restore), Personal Dictionary (MUSE_STATS), Contact Names, Cursor-Aware & Append-Only Editing, and App Context. Designed to stack conflict-free alongside upstream GboardWu (including v4.5.0+ Clipboard Select All). Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 and tested on 18.8.0.
